shader_cost.interpretation: First launch of a fresh mesh-material shader source hash versus the next no-change warm launch, identical argv apart from receipt paths. Both use synchronous material compilation and two requested workers. Wall time includes all loading and the minimum 10-second/3-second-quiet probe, excludes admission, and is not a throughput benchmark. Material counts are cache-miss log events and distinct names; the successful final ready/zero-pending receipt establishes completion. The original before-type baseline is retained separately. No DDC was deleted.
